200135127.title: Analysis of local glucocorticoid receptor occupancy at glucocorticoid-repressed inflammatory enhancers in Beas-2B airway epithelial cells II
200135127.summary: This study combined ChIP-seq using two different GR antibodies and stable GR knockdown in Beas-2B airway epithelial cells to determine whether glucocorticoid-mediated repression of inflammatory enhancers requires local GR occupancy
200135127.gdstype: Genome binding/occupancy profiling by high throughput sequencing
